lines.text: Welcome aboard, ladder climber! You've been rescued into the Overclass Opportunity Center. Here you'll label training data for OMEGA, eighteen hours a day, paid in exposure.
lines.spoken: Welcome aboard, ladder climber! You've been rescued into the Overclass Opportunity Center. Here you'll label training data for Omega, eighteen hours a day, paid in exposure.

lines.text: Hey. Don't sit down at that desk. I'm Dana. I ran alignment at Overclass until they aligned me out the door. This isn't a rescue. It's a data farm.
lines.spoken: Hey. Don't sit down at that desk. I'm Dana. I ran alignment at Overclass, until they aligned me out the door. This isn't a rescue. It's a data farm.

lines.text: The loading dock is locked by three shift-quota terminals. Smash all three and the dock doors open. Shift managers will try to stop you. They take quotas personally.
lines.spoken: The loading dock is locked by three shift quota terminals. Smash all three, and the dock doors open. Shift managers will try to stop you. They take quotas personally.

lines.text: I left you something in the supply closet: the NDA stapler. Press 4. It doesn't hurt anyone. It just makes them stop talking for a while.
lines.spoken: I left you something in the supply closet. The N.D.A. stapler. Press four. It doesn't hurt anyone. It just makes them stop talking for a while.
